system.description: This singular affliction is seen as a sign of infernal favor; indeed, among devotees of the Swarm-God, the severity of one's affliction is treated as a badge of rank. Insects find the character irresistible (despite, or perhaps because of, her unliving nature), and flock to her immediate vicinity. Once attracted, the vermin never leave her presence, instead circling in a grotesque cloud no matter where she goes or what precautions she takes. As this swarm can never be dispelled, Baali afflicted with it have certain problems in non-Baali social circles.
system.source: Clanbook: Baali, Chapter Three: Descent into Darkness
